label: Merging adjacent minterms
subgoals: Group the minterms by their number of 1 bits
Merge pairs from neighboring groups that differ in one bit
Check off every entry that participates in a merge

label: Iterating to the prime implicants
subgoals: Merge cubes with equal dash positions that differ in one bit
Discard duplicate cubes reached by different merges
Collect the unchecked entries as the prime implicants

label: Don't cares and the hand-off to covering
section: Don't cares and the hand-off to covering
subgoals: Merge don't cares as 1s during prime generation
Keep only primes that cover at least one ON minterm
Pass the primes and ON minterms to the covering phase
